entities.summary: Sergey Makhovikov (b. 1963-10-22, Saint Petersburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Saint Petersburg and Russia. Known in the fields of russia, composers & musicians, europe.
